feed.subtitle: Every release entry from the Vir Invictus workspace's patchnotes, newest first.

entry.title: Commonplace 0.6.1: vir-gtk 1.5.0 adoption: the app-tier quiet-toggle shim is gone; the upstream default now does what it was fighting for.
Commonplace 0.6.0: The app rises, Phases 10-11 of the roadmap: the first GTK4 window, the live list, and the search-field state machine that is the whole reason the port exists.
Commonplace 0.5.0: The CLI arc, Phases 8-9 of the roadmap: the first runnable artifact.

Commonplace 0.4.0: The render boundary and export core, Phases 6-7 of the roadmap: with this release the engine is feature-complete (it loads, searches, sorts, filters, writes, tags, links, renders, and exports a notes folder, all headless), and the CLI and GUI arcs are next.
Docket 1.1.3: vir-gtk lock moved 1.4.3 → 1.5.0 (`d37ef6e`): the shared base sheet's checked/active default went quiet (upstream issue #1; state display stops spending the accent).
Greyfall 0.1.0: Project Seeded
bindery-cli 1.2.4: The cover analyzer resolves hrefs against the OPF (issue #36)
bindery-cli 1.2.3: The census cap fix: observe against epubcheck 5.4.0

dragon-agents 1.6.2: One charter patch from the standing debug-report duty (issue #12): the pixel-judge Bash allowlist gains `magick` (`convert` as the ImageMagick 6 name) so a dispatch can crop a capture region and print channel statistics instead of eyeballing a low-amplitude artifact (recorded live on a phase-10 window acceptance, where the seat could not quantify a faint ghost region because only full-file `identify` was allowlisted).
dragon-agents 1.6.1: Four charter patches from the standing debug-report duty, batched under the 2026-11-13 policy.
vir-gtk 1.5.0: The base sheet's checked default goes quiet: state display stops spending the accent (issue #1).
annals 0.7.0: The Adoption section: package download totals in the record, so the work log shows reach alongside the work.

dragon-agents 1.6.0: The comparative-design and marketing wave: one new read-only seat, the fleet's first in-repo authored skill, four charter patches from the comparative seat-design report, the evals convention, and a README rebuilt for readability.
dragon-agents 1.5.0: The life-domains wave plus the fleet's first vendored skills: two new read-only seats, one shared charter line on every charter, and skills/ in the repo.

dragon-agents 1.4.0: The issue-and-propagation wave: five new seats drafted by charter-architect from the roster-expansion campaign (a 28-source prior-art report, a full sweep of the workspace's workflow corpus, and usage mining), riding one release with a release-auditor method patch.
dragon-agents 1.3.4: One shared charter line across all thirty agents, from the standing debug-report duty (issue #7): zsh shell discipline.

whisker-street 0.8.0: The bot entry point answers `--help` and `--version` before the environment is read (issue #1): a machine with no `DISCORD_TOKEN` configured now gets the usage text or the version string instead of a `ConfigError` traceback.
Atrium 0.77.0: fixture guard + consumer-wave catch-up
CalibreQuarry 3.93.0: The evidence extractor widens past a late copyright leaf (issue #70)
CalibreQuarry 3.92.0: The duplicate screen learns print-shop junk seeds (issue #68)
CalibreQuarry 3.91.0: The cover ladder grows a DJVU rung and a page-2 arm (issues #67 and #69)
Catagotchi 4.51.2: The Releases Page Gets the Real Notes
Catagotchi 4.51.1: The Docs Tell the Truth
Colophon 2.6.2: A release-engineering fix, cutting its own proof: nothing in the app changes, and no number moves.
Colophon 2.6.1: A maintenance release from the CI-repair lane: nothing you see moves, and none of your numbers change.

Commonplace 0.3.0: The write path and the tag/link layer, Phases 4-5 of the roadmap: the engine now writes notes with nvALT's file rules and carries the tag and link graph, still dependency-free and headless.
Commonplace 0.2.0: The engine arc, Phases 1-3 of the roadmap: `commonplace-core` now loads a notes folder the way nvALT reads one and powers the find-as-you-type search headlessly.

Commonplace 0.1.0: Initial skeleton: three-crate workspace (the `commonplace-core` engine, the `commonplace` GTK4 shell, `commonplace-cli`), CI shaped from Docket's hardened workflow, the committed research notes under `research/`, and the port roadmap in `roadmap.md`.

Framework 1.0.3: The tracker-reconciliation release: the one genuinely open defect from the 2026-11-13 ring audit's move of the 2026-09-12 wave-4 findings to GitHub (issue #3) is fixed, with a regression test that fails without the guard.
Hearth 0.13.70: The move-catalog sync test: the drift class both tracker issues exemplified can no longer ride a release.
Hearth 0.13.69: The tracker-close release: issues #1 and #2 re-verified against the tree, their live residuals fixed, and the docs brought to the post-blitz truth.
bindery-cli 1.2.2: The half-spine veto (issue #35): the shell census read the wrong layout
